prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Phoenix for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, the severity of injuries, your goals (settlement vs trial), and who you feel comfortable working with. I can help you find a strong match. A few practical steps and criteria will get you to the best attorney for your situation:

What to look for
- Substantial car-accident/personal-injury experience and a trial record (not just settlements).  
- Board certifications, Martindale‑Hubbell AV ratings, Super Lawyers listings, or similar peer-reviewed recognitions.  
- Good client reviews and verifiable results (past verdicts/settlements) for cases like yours.  
- Contingency-fee agreement (most PI lawyers only get paid if you win).  
- Clear communication, responsiveness, and a dedicated team (paralegals, nurse case managers).  
- No disciplinary history with the State Bar of Arizona.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?  
- What results have you obtained for cases like mine?  
- Who will handle day-to-day work on my file?  
- What fees and costs do you charge? Any out-of-pocket expenses I’m responsible for?  
- What is your estimate of my case’s value and timeline?  
- How will you keep me updated?

Immediate steps if you haven’t hired counsel yet
- Get medical care and follow your doctor’s advice.  
- Preserve evidence: photos of vehicles, scene, injuries; witness contact info; repair estimates; medical bills.  
- Get the police report and keep all insurance communications. Don’t sign releases or accept the insurer’s first offer without talking to a lawyer.  
- Note deadlines: Arizona’s statute of limitations for personal injury is generally two years from the date of injury (with exceptions).

If you want, I can:
- Search for top-rated personal injury/car-accident lawyers in Phoenix and give a short vetted list (with ratings, specialties, and contact info). If that would help, tell me your ZIP code and any preferences (e.g., severe injury, minor injury, Spanish-speaking, prefer a trial lawyer).

Which would you prefer — a curated list of Phoenix attorneys now, or guidance on how to choose from options you already have?
